decision.question: Adopt €12/employee/month SaaS + €5,500 Hardware pricing for ZenithCred?
decision.recommendation: Adopt - Validated vs Headspace/Wellable. Hardware creates switching costs and de-risks pure-software competition.
evidence: 78% SaaS gross margins validated by benchmark models

options.label: Lower SaaS / Higher HW
options.description: Slower ARR growth, faster HW payback

options.label: Lease Model
options.description: Reduce upfront barrier but higher financing cost
